name: tech-writing
title: Tech-writing skills
summary: Docs skills filled in with your product's specifics: release notes, hotfix notes, docs-vs-source validation, draw.io diagram authoring, and a Gemini (agy) second-opinion style review.

cli.name: agy
cli.why: docs-gemini-style-review runs the agy CLI headlessly for the second opinion.

cli.name: python3
cli.why: The draw.io export/decode scripts are Python.

cli.name: python
cli.why: The draw.io export/decode scripts are Python.

writingSkills.prompt: Which tech-writing skills should be installed?

choices.label: Release notes
choices.description: User-facing release notes / changelog entries for a feature.

choices.label: Docs vs source validation
choices.description: Validate docs claims against the product's source repo.

choices.label: draw.io diagrams
choices.description: Author editable .drawio.svg diagrams in the house style (needs Python).

choices.label: Gemini style review
choices.description: Second-opinion prose review with the agy CLI against your style guides.

DOCS_LINK_SYNTAX.prompt: How documentation links are written on your docs platform (e.g. a component or markdown link form)

RELEASE_NOTES_PATH.prompt: Where release note files live in the docs repo

CHANGELOG_URL.prompt: Where the public changelog is published

CATEGORIES_FILE_PATH.prompt: File containing the official list of changelog categories

SOURCE_REPO_PATH.prompt: Local path of the product source checkout
SOURCE_REPO_PATH.infer: sibling checkouts next to this repo

SOURCE_REPO_URL.prompt: Remote URL of the product source repo

SOURCE_DEFAULT_BRANCH.prompt: The product source repo's primary branch

SOURCE_TEST_DIR.prompt: Where the test suite lives in the product source repo

SOLUTION_OR_ENTRY_POINT.prompt: The source repo's solution file or main entry point

TECH_STACK.prompt: The product source repo's tech stack, one line

TEST_NAMING_PATTERN.prompt: How tests are named in the product source repo (e.g. *Tests.cs)

ASSETS_ROOT.prompt: Root directory for docs image assets (e.g. public/assets)

STYLE_GUIDE_PATH.prompt: Your diagram style guide (shape libraries, palette, font)

EXAMPLE_DIAGRAM_PATH.prompt: A reference diagram in the house style

MARKDOWN_SYNTAX_REF.prompt: Doc describing your docs platform's image/asset syntax

STYLE_GUIDE_DIR.prompt: Repo-relative folder holding the prose style guides

CONTENT_GLOB.prompt: Where docs content lives (glob, e.g. content/**)

AGY_MODEL.prompt: agy model id for style reviews (the highest reasoning tier)

todo.text: Replace the generic examples in the release/hotfix notes skills with real entries from your changelog — the examples anchor the voice.
Fill in docs-source-validation/references/solution-map.md; offer to generate it by exploring the source repo (with consent — it's a large read).
Create the categories file at CATEGORIES_FILE_PATH if it doesn't exist — the hotfix skill hard-depends on it.
Confirm the diagram style guide and example diagram exist at the paths given.
Put the prose style guides in STYLE_GUIDE_DIR and fill in the guide table and corpus quirks in the skill; then run its preflight.sh.
